summary_en: Tender offer period for Shinko Shoji (8141) extended from 2026-06-26 to 2026-07-14 (42 business days total). Tender price ¥1,580/share unchanged. Minimum acceptance threshold 19,226,700 shares. Purpose: make subsidiary (完全子会社化). Target board recommends participation; final decision to shareholders.
title_en: Notice of Extension of Tender Offer Period for Ordinary Shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 8141)
translation_en_brief: Kaga Electronics Co., Ltd. (8154), the offeror in an ongoing tender offer for Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (8141), announced on 2026-06-26 that it has extended the tender offer period to 2026-07-14, increasing the total duration from 30 business days to 42 business days. The tender price remains ¥1,580 per share, and the minimum acceptance threshold is 19,226,700 shares. The stated purpose is to make Shinko Shoji a wholly-owned subsidiary (完全子会社化). The extension was decided to provide target shareholders with additional time to consider participation, based on subscription trends and forward outlook. Shinko Shoji's board of directors has expressed support for the offer and recommends that shareholders make their own decision on participation; the board regards the ¥1,580 price as adequately reflecting the target company's value and as offering shareholders a reasonable opportunity to sell their shares.
